title: Simply Good Foods (SMPL): Stifel Nicolaus Reaffirms Buy Rating Today, Has a Target of $22/Share
text:
Posted by Adrian Mccoy 09 pm Simply Good Foods (SMPL) Rating Reaffirmed
In analysts report revealed this morning, Stifel Nicolaus reiterated their Buy rating on Simply Good Foods (SMPL) shares. The target gives a possible upside of 15.12 % from firm’s last stock close. The Simply Good Foods Company (NASDAQ:SMPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 3 analysts covering Simply Good Foods ( SMPL ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 0 Hold. Therefore 100% are positive. Simply Good Foods has $22 highest and $18 lowest target. $20’s average target is 4.66% above currents $19.11 stock price. Simply Good Foods had 3 analyst reports since July 11, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus with “Buy” on Wednesday, July 11.
The stock decreased 4.07% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $19.11. About 886,559 shares traded or 37.03% up from the average. The Simply Good Foods Company (SMPL) has risen 43.11% since January 5, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 43.11% the S&P500.
The Simply Good Foods Company develops, markets, and sells branded nutritional foods and snack products in North America and internationally. The company has market cap of $1.57 billion. The firm markets nutrition bars, ready-to-drink shakes, snacks, and confectionery products under the Atkins, SimplyProtein, Atkins Endulge, and Atkins Harvest Trail brand names. It has a 19.91 P/E ratio.
